claims.statement: Eros is the Greek god of love and passionate desire.
claims.statement_id: Eros adalah dewa Yunani yang berkaitan dengan cinta dan hasrat.
claims.quote: Eros was the Greek god of love, or more precisely, passionate and physical desire.

claims.statement: One tradition describes Eros as a primordial god emerging at creation.
claims.statement_id: Satu tradisi menggambarkan Eros sebagai dewa purba yang muncul pada awal penciptaan.
claims.quote: EROS was the primordial god (protogenos) of procreation who emerged self-formed at the dawn of creation.

claims.statement: In another tradition, the younger Eros is Aphrodite's son carrying bow and arrows.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi lain, Eros muda adalah putra Aphrodite yang membawa busur dan panah.
claims.quote: The younger Eros, a mischievous godling armed with bow and arrows, was a son of the goddess Aphrodite.

claims.statement: One genealogy makes Eros the son of Aphrodite and Ares.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu silsilah menyebut Eros putra Aphrodite dan Ares.
claims.quote: He was also sometimes regarded as the child of Aphrodite, with Ares, the god of war, as his father

claims.statement: Eros's arrows were said to make humans, heroes, and gods fall in love.
claims.statement_id: Panah Eros dikisahkan membuat manusia, pahlawan, dan dewa jatuh cinta.
claims.quote: It was thought that Eros' arrows, often randomly aimed, made people, heroes, and gods fall in love - no one was immune.

claims.statement: Eros fell in love with and married Psyche despite Aphrodite's opposition.
claims.statement_id: Eros jatuh cinta dan menikahi Psyche meskipun Aphrodite menentangnya.
claims.quote: Eros was not himself immune to the powers of love, and he famously fell for and married Psyche against the wishes of his mother Aphrodite.

claims.statement: Eros received cult worship at Thespiae, Athens, Megara, and other places.
claims.statement_id: Eros dipuja antara lain di Thespiae, Athena, dan Megara.
claims.quote: In Greek religion, Eros was the subject of cult worship in Thespiae (with its sporting and artistic festival, the Erotidia) and at Athens, Megara, Philadelphia, Leuctra, Velia, and Parium.

claims.statement: Classical art usually portrays Eros as a winged youth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani klasik, Eros lazim digambarkan sebagai pemuda bersayap.
claims.quote: In Classical art he is usually represented as a beautiful winged youth.

claims.statement: In the Hellenistic period, depiction of Eros as a baby became common.
claims.statement_id: Pada zaman Helenistik, gambaran Eros sebagai bayi mulai menonjol.
claims.quote: During the Hellenistic period (323–31 B.C.) a new image of the god as a baby took hold.

claims.statement: Cupid is the Roman counterpart of Eros.
claims.statement_id: Cupid adalah padanan Romawi Eros.
claims.quote: Eros is the Greek god of love and Cupid is his Roman equivalent.

claims.statement: Eros picks his targets without warning and strikes their hearts, causing confusion and overwhelming feelings.
claims.statement_id: Tanpa peringatan Eros memilih sasarannya dan menyerang hati mereka dengan keras, membawa kebingungan dan perasaan yang tak tertahankan.
claims.quote: Without warning Eros selects his targets and forcefully strikes at their hearts, bringing confusion and irrepressible feelings.

claims.statement: In Greek art Eros is most often shown as a carefree, beautiful youth crowned with flowers, especially roses, which were closely associated with him.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani Eros paling sering digambarkan sebagai pemuda tampan yang riang, bermahkota bunga, terutama mawar yang erat dikaitkan dengan sang dewa.
claims.quote: Eros is most often represented in Greek art as a carefree and beautiful youth, crowned with flowers, especially of roses which were closely associated with the god.

claims.statement: According to Hesiod's Theogony, Eros was one of the primeval gods who, with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hesiod dalam Theogony, Eros adalah salah satu dewa purba yang bersama Chaos dan Gaia (Bumi) bertanggung jawab atas penciptaan.
claims.quote: According to Hesiod in his Theogony, Eros was one of the primaeval gods who, along with Chaos and Gaia (Earth), was responsible for the Creation.

claims.statement: In other traditions such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg put by the Titan Chronos (Time) into the womb of Chaos.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi lain seperti kosmogoni Orfik, Eros lahir sebagai hermafrodit dari telur yang diletakkan Titan Chronos (Waktu) ke dalam rahim Chaos.
claims.quote: In other traditions, such as the Orphic cosmogonies, Eros is born a hermaphrodite from an egg which was put by the Titan Chronos (who represents Time) into the womb of Chaos.

claims.statement: The comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460-c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).
claims.statement_id: Penulis komedi Yunani Aristophanes (sekitar 460-380 SM) memakai gagasan serupa tetapi membuat Eros menetas dari telur perak yang dikeluarkan Nyx (Malam) dan Aither (Angin).
claims.quote: The Greek comic playwright Aristophanes (c. 460 - c. 380 BCE) uses the same idea but has Eros hatch out from a silver egg laid by Nyx (Night) and Aither (Wind).

claims.statement: In some traditions Eros had a younger brother, Anteros, a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.
claims.statement_id: Dalam beberapa tradisi, Eros punya adik bernama Anteros, sosok yang jauh lebih gelap dan pembalas cinta yang tak berbalas.
claims.quote: In some traditions, Eros also had a younger brother - Anteros - who was a much darker figure and an avenger of unrequited love.

claims.statement: In Greek myth Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions were hard to control he was considered something of a cunning trickster.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitos Yunani, Eros terutama dikaitkan dengan kesuburan, hasrat, dan cinta seksual; karena gairah itu sulit dikendalikan, sang dewa dianggap semacam penipu yang licik.
claims.quote: In the Greek myths, Eros was associated above all with fertility, desire and sexual love, and because such passions could prove very difficult to control, the god was considered something of a cunning trickster.

claims.statement: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous, but at other times cruel with surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion.
claims.statement_id: Kadang sang dewa bermain-main dan jahil tanpa bahaya, tetapi di waktu lain ia kejam dengan serangan mendadak yang hanya membawa nafsu gegabah dan kebingungan.
claims.quote: Sometimes the god is playful and harmlessly mischievous but at other times he is cruel with his surprise attacks that bring only reckless passion and confusion

claims.statement: According to the source, Eros's lack of discipline and general unreliability may explain why he was never counted among the 12 Olympian gods.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penulis sumber ini, kurangnya disiplin dan ketidakandalan Eros mungkin menjelaskan mengapa ia tak pernah dianggap salah satu dari 12 dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: The lack of discipline and general unreliability of Eros may explain why he was never considered one of the 12 Olympian Gods.

claims.statement: Eros was also considered the specific protector of homosexual love.
claims.statement_id: Eros juga dianggap pelindung khusus cinta sesama jenis.
claims.quote: Finally, Eros was considered the specific protector of homosexual love.

claims.statement: In one famous episode Apollo ridiculed Eros's skill as an archer, and Eros shot one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu kisah terkenal: Apollo mengejek kemampuan Eros memanah, lalu Eros menembakkan panah ke dewa besar itu sehingga ia jatuh cinta pada nimfa Daphne.
claims.quote: One of the most famous episodes involving this trick was when Apollo ridiculed the skills of Eros as an archer and the latter fired one of his arrows at the great god, making him fall in love with the nymph Daphne.

claims.statement: Another instance: Eros made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, who seized the Golden Fleece.
claims.statement_id: Contoh lain: Eros membuat Medea jatuh cinta pada pahlawan besar Jason, pengambil Bulu Domba Emas.
claims.quote: Another such instance of Eros using his love-carrying arrows was when he made Medea fall in love with the great hero Jason, he who grabbed the Golden Fleece.

claims.statement: Altars to Eros were placed at the Academy of Athens and at the gymnasium at Elis.
claims.statement_id: Altar bagi Eros didirikan di Akademi Athena dan di gimnasium Elis.
claims.quote: Altars to Eros were placed at both the Academy of Athens and the gymnasium at Elis

claims.statement: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE Eros is usually depicted as a winged adolescent who often carries a victory wreath.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno sejak abad ke-6 SM, Eros biasanya digambarkan sebagai remaja bersayap yang sering membawa karangan bunga kemenangan.
claims.quote: In ancient Greek art from the 6th century BCE, Eros is usually depicted as an adolescent with wings and he often carries a wreath of victory.

claims.statement: Eros is shown carrying a bow with any frequency only from the 4th century BCE, though the first literary reference is much earlier, in Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).
claims.statement_id: Eros baru sering digambarkan membawa busur sejak abad ke-4 SM, meski rujukan sastra pertamanya jauh lebih awal, dalam Iphigenia in Aulis karya Euripides (sekitar 406 SM).
claims.quote: Surprisingly, he is only depicted carrying a bow with any great frequency from the 4th century BCE, although the first literary reference is much earlier and found in the tragedian Euripides' Iphigenia in Aulis (c. 406 BCE).

claims.statement: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, called Erotes, symbolizing the different forms love can take.
claims.statement_id: Sosok Eros juga dapat muncul berdua atau bertiga, disebut Erotes, yang melambangkan berbagai bentuk cinta.
claims.quote: Figures of Eros can also appear in twos or threes, when they are referred to as Erotes, symbolic of the different forms love can take.

claims.statement: Only in later Roman art is Eros, under his new name Cupid, commonly portrayed as a chubby, mischievous baby.
claims.statement_id: Baru dalam seni Romawi kemudian Eros, dengan nama barunya Cupid, lazim digambarkan sebagai bayi montok dan jahil.
claims.quote: It is only in later Roman art that Eros, under his new name Cupid, is commonly portrayed rather unflatteringly as a chubby and mischievous baby.

claims.statement: In Plato's Symposium a speaker calls Love the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Symposium karya Plato, tokoh yang berbicara menyebut Cinta sebagai dewa tertua, paling dihormati, dan paling berkuasa dalam membantu manusia meraih keutamaan dan kebahagiaan.
claims.quote: Therefore I say Love is the most ancient of the gods, the most honoured, and the most powerful in helping men gain virtue and blessedness.

claims.statement: Eros is also present on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Eros juga hadir pada friso timur Parthenon, digambarkan sebagai anak di samping Aphrodite.
claims.quote: he is present, too, on the east frieze of the Parthenon, shown as a child next to Aphrodite.

claims.statement: Eros was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos; the Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.
claims.statement_id: Eros adalah daya pendorong lahirnya kehidupan baru di kosmos; kaum Orfik menamainya Phanes, makhluk purba yang menetas dari telur dunia.
claims.quote: He was the driving force behind the generation of new life in the cosmos. The Orphics named him Phanes, a primal being hatched from the world-egg.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros is fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony, Eros adalah yang tertampan di antara para dewa abadi, yang melemahkan anggota tubuh dan menaklukkan pikiran serta nasihat bijak semua dewa dan manusia.
claims.quote: and Eros (Love) [Procreation], fairest among the deathless gods, who unnerves the limbs and overcomes the mind and wise counsels of all gods and all men within them.

claims.statement: In Aristophanes' Birds black-winged Nyx lays an egg in the deeps of Erebos, and after long ages the graceful Eros springs from it with glittering golden wings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Birds karya Aristophanes, Nyx bersayap hitam bertelur dalam kedalaman Erebos, dan setelah zaman-zaman panjang lahirlah Eros yang anggun dengan sayap emas berkilau.
claims.quote: Firstly, black-winged Nyx (Night) laid a germless egg in the bosom of the infinite deeps of Erebos (Darkness), and from this, after the revolution of long ages, sprang the graceful Eros [the primordial Eros] with his glittering golden wings

claims.statement: Theoi translates the name Eros as "sexual desire".
claims.statement_id: Theoi mengartikan nama Eros sebagai "hasrat seksual".
claims.quote: Translation Sexual Desire (eros)

claims.statement: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.
claims.statement_id: Dialah yang menyalakan api cinta di hati para dewa dan manusia, bersenjatakan busur dan panah atau obor menyala.
claims.quote: It was he who lit the flame of love in the hearts of the gods and men, armed with either a bow and arrows or a flaming torch.

claims.statement: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Eros sering digambarkan sebagai anak Aphrodite yang tidak penurut tetapi sangat setia.
claims.quote: Eros was often portrayed as the disobedient but fiercely loyal child of Aphrodite.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses Eros has two opposing arrows: one rouses love with a piercing gold point, the other routs it with a blunt tip of lead.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, Eros memiliki dua panah berlawanan: satu membangkitkan cinta dengan ujung emas runcing, satu lagi mengusirnya dengan ujung timbal yang tumpul.
claims.quote: one shaft that rouses love and one that routs it. The first gleams bright with piercing point of gold; the other, cull and blunt is tipped with lead.

claims.statement: According to Pausanias, most men consider Eros the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Pausanias, kebanyakan orang menganggap Eros dewa termuda dan putra Aphrodite.
claims.quote: Most men consider Eros to be the youngest of the gods and the son of Aphrodite.

claims.statement: According to a scholion, Alcaeus said Eros was the child of Iris and Zephyros, while Sappho made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos.
claims.statement_id: Menurut sebuah scholion, Alkaios menyebut Eros anak Iris dan Zephyros, sedangkan Sappho menjadikannya anak Aphrodite dan Ouranos.
claims.quote: Alkaios (Alcaeus) [Greek poet C6th B.C.] said Eros was the child of Iris (Rainbow) and Zephyros (West Wind); Sappho [Greek poet C6th B.C.] made him the child of Aphrodite and Ouranos (Uranus, Heaven).

claims.statement: In the Symposium Eros is conceived (by Penia) and, being a lover of beauty and born on Aphrodite's birthday, becomes her follower and attendant.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Symposium, Eros dikandung (oleh Penia) dan, karena mencintai keindahan serta lahir pada hari ulang tahun Aphrodite, ia menjadi pengikut dan pelayannya.
claims.quote: conceived Eros (Love), who partly because he is naturally a lover of the beautiful, and because Aphrodite is herself beautiful, and also because he was born on her birthday, is her follower and attendant.

claims.statement: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros tames lions and tigers, breaks Zeus's thunderbolts, deprives Heracles of his arms, and sports with sea monsters.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, Eros menjinakkan singa dan harimau, mematahkan petir Zeus, merampas senjata Heracles, dan bermain dengan monster laut.
claims.quote: he tames lions and tigers, breaks the thunderbolts of Zeus, deprives Heracles of his arms, and carries on his sport with the monsters of the sea.

claims.statement: Things sacred to Eros that often accompany him in art include the rose, wild beasts he tames, the hare, the cock, and the ram.
claims.statement_id: Hal-hal yang suci bagi Eros dan sering menyertainya dalam karya seni mencakup mawar, binatang buas yang ia jinakkan, kelinci, ayam jantan, dan domba jantan.
claims.quote: Among the things sacred to Eros, and which frequently appear with him in works of art, we may mention the rose, wild beasts which are tamed by him, the hare, the cock, and the ram.

claims.statement: Eros was a favourite subject of ancient sculptors, and his image seems to have been perfected by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of perfect beauty.
claims.statement_id: Eros adalah subjek favorit para pematung kuno, dan penggambarannya tampaknya disempurnakan oleh Praxiteles, yang membayangkannya sebagai pemuda dewasa berparas paling sempurna.
claims.quote: Eros was a favourite subject with the ancient statuaries, but his representation seems to have been brought to perfection by Praxiteles, who conceived him as a full-grown youth of the most perfect beauty.

claims.statement: Homer does not mention Eros; Hesiod, the earliest author to mention him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.
claims.statement_id: Homer tidak menyebut Eros; Hesiod, penulis paling awal yang menyebutnya, menggambarkannya sebagai Eros kosmogonik.
claims.quote: Homer does not mention Eros, and Hesiod, the earliest author that mentions him, describes him as the cosmogonic Eros.

claims.statement: In Hyginus's tale, when Typhon appeared at the Euphrates, Venus (Aphrodite) and her son Cupid (Eros) threw themselves into the river and changed into fishes, escaping danger.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Hyginus, ketika Typhon muncul di tepi Efrat, Venus (Aphrodite) dan putranya Cupid (Eros) terjun ke sungai dan berubah wujud menjadi ikan sehingga selamat.
claims.quote: once Venus [Aphrodite] and her son Cupid [Eros] came in Syria to the river Euphrates. There Typhon [Typhoeus], of whom we have already spoken, suddenly appeared. Venus [Aphrodite] and her son threw themselves into the river and there changed their forms to fishes, and by so doing this escaped danger.

claims.statement: In Ovid's Metamorphoses, as Eros kissed his mother, an arrow from his quiver unknowingly grazed Aphrodite's breast.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Metamorphoses karya Ovid, ketika Eros mencium ibunya, sebuah panah dari tabungnya tanpa sengaja menggores dada Aphrodite.
claims.quote: Once, when Venus' [Aphrodite's] son [Eros] was kissing her, his quiver dangling down, a jutting arrow, unbeknown, had grazed her breast.

claims.statement: In Hesiod's Theogony Eros and comely Himeros (Desire) followed Aphrodite at her birth and as she went into the assembly of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Theogony, Eros dan Himeros (Hasrat) mengikuti Aphrodite sejak kelahirannya dan ketika ia memasuki majelis para dewa.
claims.quote: Eros (Love), and comely Himeros (Desire) followed her [Aphrodite] at her birth at the first and as she went into the assembly of the gods.

claims.statement: In Nonnus's Dionysiaca, when Typhoeus besieged Olympos, bold Eros fled in panic, leaving his arrows behind.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Dionysiaca karya Nonnus, ketika Typhoeus mengepung Olimpus, Eros yang berani lari panik dengan meninggalkan panah-panahnya.
claims.quote: [When the monster Typhoeus besieged Olympos :] ... for bold Eros has flown in panic, leaving behind his generative arrows

claims.statement: In Apollonius's Argonautica, Athena says that, sprung from Zeus, she has never felt the arrows of the Boy (Eros).
claims.statement_id: Dalam Argonautica karya Apollonius, Athena menyatakan bahwa ia, yang lahir dari Zeus, tak pernah merasakan panah sang Anak (Eros).
claims.quote: Sprung as I am from Zeus, I have never felt the arrows of the Boy [i.e. Eros], and of love-charms I know nothing.

claims.statement: Theoi lists Hedone as Eros's offspring by Psyche, citing Apuleius.
claims.statement_id: Theoi mencatat Hedone sebagai anak Eros dan Psyche menurut Apuleius.
claims.quote: OFFSPRING [1.1] HEDONE (by Psykhe) (Apuleius 6.24)

claims.statement: The scene of Eros and Himeros accompanying Aphrodite was particularly popular in ancient art, the godlings fluttering about the goddess reclining in a conch-shell.
claims.statement_id: Adegan Eros dan Himeros mengiringi Aphrodite sangat populer dalam seni kuno; para dewa kecil itu beterbangan di sekitar sang dewi yang bersandar dalam cangkang kerang.
claims.quote: The scene was particular popular in ancient art where the godlings flutter about the goddess as she reclines inside a conch-shell.
